label: Diagram 9.2
caption: Diagram 9.2 Ladders a maximum of 6m long
description: A line elevation shows a ladder leaning diagonally against a vertical wall. A horizontal line at the bottom represents the ground and is labelled "Suitable firm level surface in a safe place". A vertical line on the right represents the wall, with a window near the top indicated by an arrow and the label "Window". The ladder is drawn resting its feet on the ground line and reaching up to the wall. A dimension line running parallel to the ladder reads "Not more than 6m". At the base of the ladder, a curved arc marks the angle between the ladder and the ground, labelled "75°". In the upper left corner is the text "See para 9.1b(i)". Below the drawing, a sentence reads "Special safety features are not necessary if the ladder is not more than 6m long." A green band along the bottom carries the caption "Diagram 9.2 Ladders a maximum of 6m long".
